mapper.sql: id, branch_id, customer_id, status, reward_id, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT min_interval_minutes, max_stamps_per_day, require_staff_approval, pending_timeout_minutes, enforce_business_hours FROM stamp_policies WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} OR branch_id IS NULL ORDER BY branch_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT business_hours::text FROM branches WHERE id = #{branchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty_accounts (id, customer_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT created_at FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND source = 'NFC_TAP' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND local_date = #{day} AND source = 'NFC_TAP' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stamps (id, branch_id, customer_id, tag_id, tap_token_id, source, status, local_date, confirmed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{branchId}, #{customerId}, #{tagId}, #{tapTokenId}, 'NFC_TAP', #{status}, #{day}, #{confirmedAt}, #{at})

INSERT INTO stamps (id, branch_id, customer_id, source, status, local_date, reason, created_by_staff_id, confirmed_at, confirmed_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{branchId}, #{customerId}, 'MANUAL', 'CONFIRMED', #{day}, #{reason}, #{staffId}, #{at}, #{staffId}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stamps WHERE id = #{stampId} FOR UPDATE

UPDATE loyalty_accounts SET current_stamps = current_stamps + 1, total_stamps = total_stamps + 1, last_stamp_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} RETURNING current_stamps
mapper.update: UPDATE stamps SET reward_id = #{rewardId} WHERE id = #{stampId}
mapper.select: SELECT current_stamps FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT name FROM branches WHERE id = #{branchId}

SELECT s.id, s.branch_id, s.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone_masked, s.created_at FROM stamps s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.branch_id = #{branchId} AND s.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY s.created_at LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE stamps SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{now}, confirmed_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = #{stampId}
UPDATE stamps SET status = 'REJECTED', revoke_reason = #{reason}, revoked_at = #{now}, revoked_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = #{stampId}

UPDATE stamps s SET status = 'REJECTED', revoke_reason = 'PENDING_TIMEOUT', revoked_at = #{now} WHERE s.status = 'PENDING' AND s.created_at + make_interval(mins => ( SELECT p.pending_timeout_minutes FROM stamp_policies p WHERE p.branch_id = s.branch_id OR p.branch_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.branch_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)) <= #{now}
